name: Channel Free
description: Live-TV channels built from your own library. Shuffled shows, movie marathons and a real TV guide — no extra containers, nothing streams unless someone's watching.
overview: Your library, on the air. Own your channels.

versions.changelog: 0.9.4: one-click setup — a 'Connect to Live TV' button adds the M3U tuner and XMLTV guide in Jellyfin for you (and fixes them if the links go stale). 0.9.3: fresh installs pick a starter lineup from your library — the 10 channels it can fill best (no near-duplicates), numbered 101+; the rest start off. 'Re-pick my lineup' button in Setup & settings. 0.9.2: built-in channels get generic names for new installs (After Hours, Saturday Morning, Action Pack, Classic Cinema, Tearjerkers, Prestige TV, Fright Night, Kids Classics); existing installs keep their current names. 0.9.1: channel page is one page — '+ Add to channel' opens one search for titles, genres, networks & studios and keyword tags; Rebuild schedule button in the toolbar; rules show as removable chips in the AUTO-ADD line; 'Weighted mix' label; 'package' = all your channels. 0.9.0: renamed Channel Free (new logo); settings page rebuilt — channel lineup, Even mix vs Favorites first, Tonight's Mix bar, per-show options menu, changes save instantly, guide status in the header. 0.8.3: guide-update status in settings (progress bar, queued-until-nobody-is-watching, done/failed, Update guide now); self-heal removes leftover guide entries after a rebuild (no more overlapping titles). 0.8.2: Weighted mix.
